messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Compiling Stan using g++
parts:
In Windows, I had to add a command line to get Stan to build since
we're using default template parameters. It was:
-std=gnu++0x

I tried it with -std=c++0x, but that didn't work.


Daniel

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Compiling Stan using g++ [gnu++0x]
parts:
I was talking to someone (Matt or one of my
C++ coder friends) and they suggested just having
a build file for each platform/compiler that could
then call some things in a generic build file.

Should we do this?

I'm not sure why c++0x didn't work -- it's not like
this is a gnu-specific extension. I found this reference
page:

http://gcc.gnu.org/projects/cxx0x.html

Looks like things will depend heavily on compiler
version.

- Bob
